name: Anchored Coins AEUR
oneLiner: AEUR is Anchored Coins' centralized euro stablecoin, backed 1:1 by EUR deposits at Swissquote Bank, with the issuer winding down to comply with MiCAR.
collateral: Euro reserves held 1:1 at Swissquote Bank SA (FINMA-licensed Swiss bank)

notices.title: Wind-down complete
notices.message: FlowBank SA (former reserve partner) declared bankruptcy in June 2024. Anchored Coins has restructured collateral so that 100% of circulating AEUR is backed 1:1 at Swissquote Bank SA. The issuer is winding down to comply with MiCAR and will not resume issuance; AEUR was delisted from Binance EEA in March 2025. The final redemption window closed 29 October 2026 and the AEUR Token Terms were terminated 30 October 2026; remaining holders will be settled 1:1 in another EUR stablecoin. AEUR is no longer redeemable and has no value.

obituary.epitaph: A solvent euro was retired by its license boundary
obituary.obituary: Anchored Coins stopped issuing new AEUR after MiCAR made an EU issuer license necessary for the Swiss company to continue a EUR stablecoin business. The issuer moved reserves to Swissquote and kept a high-minimum redemption route for existing holders, but announced an orderly withdrawal from stablecoins rather than a relaunch. With issuance permanently closed and the product in a regulatory wind-down, Pharos freezes AEUR as an archived legacy asset while preserving its historical market record.
